name: zhiloop
description: Dynamic, scoped knowledge retrieval and closed-loop verification for Codex

interface.shortDescription: Scoped knowledge and closed-loop checks for Codex.
interface.longDescription: ZhiLoop captures reusable conclusions, injects minimal task-relevant knowledge, exposes deeper retrieval through MCP, and verifies closure without replacing existing Codex or CCM hooks.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use ZhiLoop knowledge only when it is relevant to the current task, respect its scope and gates, and expand details through ZhiLoop MCP tools only when needed.
